_comment: Class -> RMB Class ability mapping for Omega Realm's seven archetypes. Holds which unique right-mouse-button ability each Class casts (paid in Mana, on its own cooldown), keyed by class byte. The Rust omega-server is the numeric authority: it reads the ability flag, looks up the player's Class, gates on Mana>=cost and cooldown, and resolves all damage/spawns server-side ('the client requests, the server decides'); this file mirrors the mapping for client input/VFX/tooling and the server wins on disagreement. Full per-ability parameters live per-class in client/data/classes/<id>.json (mirrored from the authoritative Rust constants). Governing GDD docs: docs/gdd/classes/index.md, docs/gdd/classes/<id>.md, docs/systems/abilities.md, data/spells/spell_database.json. SCOPE NOTE (docs/gdd/classes/index.md): only Warrior, Rogue, Mage are active in pre-alpha; the other 4 (Zealot, Void Hunter, Engineer, Plague Seer) are deferred. The high-level ability params below are ENCODED from classes/index.md; the server remains authoritative. TODO: confirm against rust/server constants; add slot-1..4 acquired-spell layering if/when that lands.

class_abilities._comment: Keyed by class byte (wire order, protocol v3+). 'active' = in pre-alpha scope; 'deferred' = disabled to limit scope. Params mirror docs/gdd/classes/index.md; authority is the Rust server.
